answer: Weight each identity only after it anchors beneath a sponsor by a committed bridge in an on-chain tree and locks a walnut bond, a scarce non-mintable deposit. Proving one identity a mirror of another collapses the subtree below their shared sponsors: settlement walks the committed tree and burns every walnut bond beneath it. A farm seeding N clones under shared sponsors freezes N bonds at once, so capital at risk grows with subtree volume, far above path-only exposure. Clones cannot re-parent to flee, and fanning out under N honest sponsors needs N outsiders each watching their own bond burn.
